description: Fetch a public web page and return its title, description, clean Markdown (scripts, styles, nav chrome removed) and the list of links. No model call, deterministic. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account; nothing is charged for a bad input).

payment.description: x402 payment: the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (x402 v2 payment payload signed for one entry of the `accepts` list returned when this tool is called without it). Omit to get the price and payment requirements.
